basic_info.description: Located in the desirable Miraloma neighborhood, this fully renovated home offers a comfortable and modern living experience. The main level features two bedrooms and two full bathrooms, including a spacious primary suite. A bright living room welcomes you in, and the updated kitchen flows into the dining area, creating an open and functional layout.  The lower level includes a third bedroom, full bathroom, and a generous family room with a wet bar. Large sliding doors open to a private deck that brings in plenty of natural light, ideal for relaxing or entertaining.  Just minutes from Glen Park Village, Tower Market, BART, City College, Mt. Davidson Park, and Glen Canyon, this home offers easy access to neighborhood amenities and transportation options. With thoughtful updates throughout, it's move-in ready and designed for today's lifestyle.
